mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, content, board_type, image_url) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{boardType}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, title, content, image_url, created_at, updated_at, view_count, like_count FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
